instruction: Fix `base64_decode` in `codec/binary.py` so it returns the decoded UTF-8 string (a str), not the raw bytes object. It currently returns the `b64decode` result directly, leaking `bytes` to callers.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/binary.py b/codec/binary.py
--- a/codec/binary.py
+++ b/codec/binary.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 
 def base64_decode(text: str) -> str:
     """Decode base64 ``text`` back into a UTF-8 string."""
-    return base64.b64decode(text)
+    return from_bytes(base64.b64decode(text))
